mapper.select: select pid,rel_number as relNumber,rel_name as relName,rel_type as relType,rel_Trade_Amount as contractAmount, MAJOR_TRADE as majorTrade,pricing_policy as pricingPolicy,'1', TRAN_TYPE as tranType from ins_tra_funds where (MAJOR_TRADE ='0') and status in ('6','9','12') and (Archiving_Status is NULL or Archiving_Status <> '1')and delflag_='1'

select pid,rel_number as relNumber,rel_name as relName ,rel_type as relType,rel_Trade_Amount as contractAmount,MAJOR_TRADE as majorTrade, pricing_policy as pricingPolicy , TRAN_TYPE as tranType from ins_tra_funds where consider_Type='2' and status in ('6','9','12') and (Archiving_Status is NULL or Archiving_Status <> '1') union all select pid,rel_number as relNumber,rel_name as relName,rel_type as relType,rel_Trade_Amount as contractAmount, MAJOR_TRADE as majorTrade,pricing_policy as pricingPolicy, TRAN_TYPE as tranType from ins_tra_funds where consider_Type ='1' and status ='6' and (Archiving_Status is NULL or Archiving_Status <> '1') and delflag_='1'
